doc.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001

title: Wrapping up with talk of a Part Two
summary: Rowe suggests a second session and thanks Locke; Locke says he just did his little bit.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, listen, this has been — I just had a feeling this was going to be a great conversation, and I’m just so happy. I think we may have to do Part Two here.
Well I’ll tell you what — yeah, let’s do Part Two. And some day we may come up to your school, man. Come to the school too.
Yeah. And I congratulate you on the part you had in the creation of all this great music, too.

Thank you. I did a little bit, but I did my little bit — I added what I could add, the little bit, just like they told me, it was the truth. You just keep doing what you can do, and it was true. That’s what’s so amazing. I didn’t understand as much as I do now. But what you can do, man, that’s good. This other guy could do that, but what you’re doing is good, now we like that. That’s what they used to always say. Coleman and Roy. They would both say that to me at different times.
